title: The CIA Turned A Cat Into A Spy 🐈
caption:
The CIA turned a cat into a spy 🐈
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In the 1960s the CIA implanted a microphone and transmitter in a cat to eavesdrop on Soviet officials. A former officer put the cost near $20 million. A CIA memo concluded it was not practical. Accounts disagree on what happened on its first mission.
Would your cat take orders? 👇
first_comment: Millions of dollars to discover that cats don't take orders. Every cat owner could've told them. 🐈👇
